annotations.text:
shopcf storefront — technical clean direction

Artboards run left to right in the order a buyer walks the site: home → category → product → application note → checkout.

IBM Plex Sans + Plex Mono; mono is reserved for part numbers, specs and quantities — the values a buyer compares character by character. Borders instead of shadows, 2px radii, one petrol accent.

Everything here becomes src/themes/default/.
The application landing page is the long-tail engine. Narrow measure so it is actually readable, plus a sticky product rail so it converts instead of only informing.
